Subject: Redwood Inference demo — proposed slots (timezone note)

Hi all,

Thanks again for your interest — excited to walk through how Redwood could fit into FinCo's payments flow. I put together a few proposed slots for a 45-minute demo and included a small ICS (proposed_times.ics) with the options:

- Wed Feb 18 at 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (next day)
- Thu Feb 19 at 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (next day)
- Fri Feb 20 at 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST (next day)

Quick notes: US daylight savings starts early March which will shift PT by 1 hour — I flagged times in the invite as local to your calendar. Also, I know some teams in APAC have upcoming region-specific OOO periods (Golden Week in late April / early May) and Diwali later in the year; if you expect people to be OOO around these dates for follow-ups, let me know and we can plan accordingly.

Please reply with the slot that works best (or propose alternatives) and I’ll send a confirmed invite.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the options. Quick context from our side: Emma (UK, CET), Sato (Tokyo), and Rajiv (Mumbai) are the core attendees. The first two slots you suggested are doable for us except that Sato flagged Golden Week planning in late April — not relevant for these Feb slots but worth keeping in mind for scheduling any follow-ups or handoffs in late April/early May.

For this demo week, Thu Feb 19 at 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (03:00 JST is a bit late for Sato but he can join for the first 30 mins if needed). Would it be possible to shift to an option that is slightly earlier for APAC without moving the time too early for the US team? Maybe Thu Feb 19 at 09:30 PT / 17:30 CET / 01:30 JST? If not, we can work with the 11:00 PT slot.

Also, FYI Rajiv will likely be OOO for Diwali in November — we may need to loop in his backup for November meetings.

Best,
Emma
EM Director, Integrations | FinCo
emma.smith@finco.co.uk
